method: Discovery and correspondence only: complete equal-length bodies preserve all opcodes, register operands, constants and intra-function branch displacements. Only real COFF/retail address operands and negative EBP local displacements are compared separately. Every accessed local byte has an injective mapping; reference-site kinds/positions and established call identities must agree. Strict scoring is unchanged.
limits: Calls without prior identities, data with initializer pointers, and conflicting public referents remain unresolved. No function is declared byte-exact merely because a local-slot mapping exists.
